_comment: Copy this file to operator_profile.json (repo root) and edit the real values. operator_profile.json is gitignored -- it is your own business data, never committed. Every field documented below.
name: solo operator (AU)
_name: Free text. How you refer to yourself/your business in reports.
_staff_count: Integer >= 0. Real headcount available to deliver work.
_certifications: List of certification codes/names you actually hold (e.g. ISO27001, OSCP, CISSP). Empty list means you confirm you hold none -- not 'unknown'.
_insurance_cover_eur: Number (EUR) or null. Professional/risk indemnity insurance cover you actually hold. null means no insurance -- not 'unknown'.
_corporate_references: List of strings naming past contracts/clients you can evidence as references. Empty list means you have none right now.
_languages: List of language codes you can genuinely work/submit in (e.g. ENG, DEU, FRA). Must have at least one entry.

business_facts._comment: Optional -- only read by the 'dossier' command. Every field is optional and defaults to unknown/absent. Never fabricate a value here -- the dossier renderer prints 'UNKNOWN -- VERIFICATION REQUIRED' for anything left null/empty, which is the honest, correct behaviour.

_business_facts_referees: Each referee entry, if any, must be an object: {"name": "...", "organisation": "...", "contact": "..."} -- all three required if you add a referee at all.
